english_text: and initiated battle against you.
Hence, you stood firm to spear and strike,

arabic_text: وَ طَحَنْتَ جُنُودَ الْفُجّارِ، وَ اقْتَحَمْتَ قَسْطَلَ الْغُبارِ،
transliteration: wa ţaħanta junūdal fujjār, waqtaħamta qasţalal ghubār,
english_text: pulverized the soldiers of the transgressors, and stormed (courageously) into the dust of the battle,

arabic_text: مُجالِداً بِذِى الْفَقارِ، كَأنَّكَ عَلِيٌّ الْمُخْتارُ،
transliteration: mujālidan bidhil faqār, ka'annaka aliyunil mukhtār,
english_text: fighting with Thulfaqar[1] as if you were Ali, the chosen one.

arabic_text: فَلَمّا رَأوْكَ ثابِتَ الْجاشِ، غَيْرَ خائِفٍ وَ لا خاشٍ،
transliteration: fallammā ra'awka thābital jāsh, ghayra khā'ifin wa lā khāsh,
english_text: So when they saw you firm, fearless, and courageous,

arabic_text: نَصَبُوا لَكَ غَوائِلَ مَكْرِهِمْ، وَ قاتَلُوكَ بِكَيْدِهِمْ وَ شَرِّهِمْ،
transliteration: našabū laka ghawā'ila makrihim, wa qātaluka bikaydihim wa sharrihim,
english_text: they set up their most malicious deceptions against you, and fought you with their deceit and viciousness.

arabic_text: وَ أمَرَ اللَّعينُ جُنُودَهُ، فَمَنَعُوكَ الْماءَ وَ وُرُودَهُ،
transliteration: wa 'amaral-laīnu junūdahu, famanaūkal mā'a wa wurūdah,
english_text: The accursed one (Umar Ibn Sa’d) commanded his soldiers, and thus, they prevented you from reaching or receiving water.

arabic_text: وَ ناجَزُوكَ الْقِتالَ، وَ عاجَلُوكَ النِّزالَ،
english_text: They rushed to engage you in combat, descended swiftly upon you,
showering you with arrows and stones,
and moving towards you with uprooting hands.

arabic_text: وَ لَمْ يَرْعَوْا لَكَ ذِماماً، وَ لا راقَبُوا فيكَ أثاماً، في قَتْلِهِمْ أوْلِياءَكَ، وَ نَهْبِهِمْ رِحالَكَ،
transliteration: wa lam yaraw laka dhimāmā, wa lā rāqabū fīka 'athāmā, fī qatlihim 'awliyā'ak, wa nahbihim riħālak,
english_text: Neither they respected your rights, nor were they mindful of retribution for slaying you and your companions, and plundering your belongings.

arabic_text: وَ أنْتَ مُقَدَّمٌ فِي الْهَبَواتِ، وَ مُحْتَمِلٌ لِلأذِيّاتِ،
transliteration: wa 'anta muqqaddamun fil habawāt, wa muħtamilun lil adhiyyāt,
english_text: You were in the front line of the storm (of battle), enduring afflictions.

arabic_text: قَدْ عَجِبَتْ مِنْ صَبْرِكَ مَلائِكَةُ السَّماواتِ،
english_text: Indeed, the angels of the heavens were astonished by your patience.
The enemy then surrounded you from all sides,
weakened you by inflicting wounds,

arabic_text: وَ حالُوا بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَ الرَّواحِ،
english_text: prevented you from taking any repose,
and you had no helper remaining.
You were bereaved yet patient,
defending your women and children,
until they caused you to fall from your horse.
You fell to the ground, wounded,
horses trampled you with their hooves,
tyrants raised their swords against you,
the sweat of death appeared on your forehead,

arabic_text: وَ اخْتَلَفَتْ بِالاِنْقِباضِ وَ الإنْبِساطِ شِمالُكَ وَ يَمينُكَ،
transliteration: wakhtalafat bil inqibāđhi wal inbisāţi shimāluka wa yamīnuk,
english_text: and you continually clenched and unclenched your hands,

arabic_text: تُديرُ طَرْفاً خَفِيّاً إلى رَحْلِكَ وَ بَيْتِكَ،
transliteration: tudīru ţarfan khafiyyan 'ilā raħlika wa baytik,
english_text: secretly gazing upon your caravan and tents,

arabic_text: وَ قَدْ شُغِلْتَ بِنَفْسِكَ عَنْ وُلْدِكَ وَ أهاليكَ،
transliteration: wa qad shughilta binafsika an wuldika wa 'ahālīk,
english_text: while trapped by yourself away from your children and family.

arabic_text: وَ أسْرَعَ فَرَسُكَ شارِداً، إلى خِيامِكَ قاصِداً، مُحَمْحِماً باكِياً،
transliteration: wa 'asraa farasuka shāridan, 'ilā khiyāmika qāšidan, muħamħiman bākiyā,
english_text: (At that time,) your horse distractedly galloped towards your camp, neighing and crying.
When the women saw your horse distraught,
and observed your saddle contorted,
